nodes.label: Crafting Metals System
nodes.rationale: Metals category: copper through starmetal ingots smelted from ore for weapons and armor.

nodes.label: Textiles Leather and Wood System
nodes.rationale: Cloth (linen to celestial cloth), Leather (light to demonhide) and Wood (oak to starwood) crafting materials.

nodes.label: Magical and Elemental Materials
nodes.rationale: Gems, Magical (mana dust, dragon blood), Elemental crystals and Misc components for enchanting.
